dzh: 这一类图是口味学习自己画的:构建时在模拟读者上真跑 design-taste,曲线和数字都是算出来的。
den: Drawn by the taste engine itself: built by running design-taste on simulated readers, every number is computed.

dzh: 五样里最难做的是笔和墨:墨分五色、提按、飞白、晕开、一方印、四种设色。
den: The hardest of the five is brush and ink: five tones, pressure, dry brush, bleed, a seal, four ways of colouring.

dzh: 常画的东西都有现成的一笔一笔画法:梅兰竹菊松、山石水云、舟亭桥、人物与鹤鱼马。
den: Things painted often, stroke by stroke: plum, orchid, bamboo, chrysanthemum, pine; rock, water, cloud; boat, pavilion, bridge; people, crane, fish, horse.

dzh: 诗竖排题在留白处,一字一字写出来,画跟着诗走。
den: The poem is written vertically into the empty paper, one character at a time, and the picture follows it.

dzh: 按季节换设色:春花青嫩绿胭脂,夏浓墨重绿,秋赭石朱膘,冬留白当雪。
den: Colouring follows the season: spring indigo, young green and rouge; summer heavy ink and green; autumn ochre and vermilion; winter leaves the paper as snow.

dzh: 远淡近浓,水和天不画,雾在山间慢慢移。
den: Far is pale, near is dark; water and sky are left unpainted; mist drifts slowly between the hills.

dzh: 泼墨、焦墨高对比,刀光剑气用飞白,一招一式按笔顺画出。
den: Splashed ink and burnt-ink contrast; a blade's flash is dry brush; each move appears in stroke order.

zh: 电影 · 动漫 · 短剧
dzh: 分镜、宽银幕推镜、角色和竖屏封面:字由代码写,不交给出图模型。
den: Storyboards, a widescreen push-in, a character and a vertical cover: words are code, never left to an image model.

dzh: 大留白,图标和时间所在的地方空着。
den: Wide empty paper; the places for icons and the clock stay empty.

dzh: 读懂优先:线必须连对,一色一事;远淡近浓分层次,数据像水沿渠流。
den: Reading first: every line connects correctly, one colour per meaning; depth by ink tone, data flowing like water in a channel.

dzh: 左边代码、右边画,同一个时钟走:高亮到哪一行,画就动到哪一步。
den: Code on one side, picture on the other, on one clock: the lit line and the picture move together.

dzh: 图里的数都由同一段代码算出来,说明文字引用的也是它。
den: Every number in the picture is computed by the same code the caption quotes.

zh: 文档 · 网页 · 界面
dzh: 水墨在界面里只做点缀:书法标题、墨痕分隔线、印章当状态,正文照样清楚好读。
den: In an interface ink is an accent: brush titles, ink rules, a seal as a status; body text stays plain and readable.

dzh: 一屏一句话,泼墨揭幕,巨大的书法字。
den: One sentence per screen, an ink-splash reveal, huge brush letters.

dzh: 墨条当柱,山脊线当折线,数由代码算。
den: Ink bars for columns, a ridge line for a line chart, numbers computed.
